paper.title: TideRL: Boosting Agentic RL Goodput with Readiness-Aware Scheduling
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models is moving toward multi-turn agentic workloads, where rollout tasks repeatedly pause for external environments, resume with growing contexts, and finish at highly variable times. summary.core_problem: 多轮Agent场景下的LLM RL训练存在三类系统性低效：一是多轮任务间歇等待环境反馈时，请求级连续批处理会驱逐KV缓存，恢复时需重复计算长上下文prefill，产生纯开销；二是训练端参考模型与actor模型共享GPU时，要么等待大批次导致GPU空闲占比最高达81%，要么频繁切换权重产生抖动开销；三是静态资源分配无法适配任务复杂度波动带来的瓶颈动态切换，最终导致训练goodput（实际推进模型更新的rollout token吞吐量）极低，现有异步RL框架架构与多轮Agent高并发、高方差的执行特性不匹配。
summary.importance: 较早针对多轮Agent RL开展全栈系统级优化的工作，将RL训练的优化目标从传统GPU占用率转向goodput，通过三个协同设计的组件同时解决多轮状态持久化、ref-actor流水线调度、弹性资源分配的耦合问题，对OSWorld、WebArena等真实交互场景的Agent RL训练可扩展性有直接支撑作用，也为RL预训练的系统设计提供了新的参考框架，属于架构级的范式改进，可显著降低Agent RL的训练成本与端到端耗时。
summary.technical_approach: 基于全局共享就绪视图构建弹性异步分布式系统，核心包含三个协同设计的组件：一是连续任务批处理（CTB），将rollout端的请求级连续批处理升级为任务级准入、抢占与恢复机制，实时跟踪每个rank的token内存占用，通过信号量控制KV缓存抢占优先级，对即将恢复的多轮任务主动固定KV缓存，避免间歇等待时被驱逐，消除重复prefill开销；二是资源感知Ref-Actor流水线（RA²P），训练端不再固定ref与actor的执行模式，根据当前就绪数据积压量与到达间隔动态切换两种模式：解耦流式模式将ref与actor部署在不同GPU，适配就绪数据多、到达快的场景，避免权重切换抖动，同机聚合模式让ref与actor共享GPU内存，适配就绪数据少、到达慢的场景，减少跨机通信，同时在微批次级别重叠ref推理与actor梯度计算，消除空闲气泡；三是弹性资源扩缩（ERS），将每个数据并行rank作为可调度资源，而非固定划分到rollout或训练组，系统实时监控当前goodput损失来源（rollout产能不足或训练端数据积压），动态在rollout与训练池之间迁移GPU rank，适配瓶颈的动态切换。
summary.experiments: 基于当前披露内容，已明确现有基线系统的瓶颈量化数据：静态ref-actor调度下GPU空闲时间占单步训练时间的比例最高达81%；多轮任务KV缓存被驱逐后，长上下文prefill的重复计算开销随对话轮次线性增长。TideRL的完整实验结果（包括goodput提升幅度、资源利用率变化、端到端训练时间缩短比例等）未在当前提供的全文片段中披露。
summary.reading_guide: 精读建议：首先重点看引言第5-7段对三类核心瓶颈的精准拆解与量化，这部分清晰指出了当前RL框架未被解决的痛点，是系统设计的核心动机；其次深入阅读三个核心组件的设计细节，尤其是CTB的任务级KV缓存管理机制、RA²P的模式切换判定条件、ERS的瓶颈识别逻辑，这三块是核心创新点；若能获取完整实验章节，优先关注不同工作负载（单轮vs多轮、不同任务复杂度分布）下的goodput对比、资源利用率曲线，以及单独启用每个组件的消融实验，明确各模块的边际收益。需特别注意「共享就绪视图」这一核心抽象，是三个组件实现协同决策的基础。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM RL training for multi-turn agentic workloads suffers from three systemic inefficiencies: first, request-level continuous batching evicts KV caches during idle waits for environment feedback, forcing redundant prefill recomputation for growing long contexts upon task resumption; second, when reference and actor models share GPUs on training nodes, the system either wastes up to 81% of per-step time waiting for large global batches, or incurs severe thrashing overhead from frequent weight swapping; third, static resource partitioning cannot adapt to dynamically shifting bottlenecks as task complexity varies, resulting in extremely low training goodput — defined as the throughput of rollout tokens that actually contribute to model updates. Existing asynchronous RL frameworks are architecturally mismatched to the high concurrency and high execution variance characteristics of multi-turn agent workloads.
summary_en.importance: One of the early full-stack system-level optimization works targeting multi-turn agentic RL, it shifts the RL training optimization objective from traditional GPU occupancy to goodput, and addresses the coupled problems of multi-turn state persistence, ref-actor pipeline scheduling, and elastic resource allocation via three co-designed components. It directly supports the scalability of agentic RL training for real-world interactive benchmarks such as OSWorld and WebArena, and provides a new reference framework for RL pretrain system design. The contribution is an architectural paradigm improvement that can significantly reduce the training cost and end-to-end wall-clock time of agentic RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: TideRL is an elastic asynchronous distributed system built around a shared global readiness view, with three core co-designed components: 1) Continuous Task Batching (CTB), which replaces request-level continuous batching on rollout ranks with task-level admission, preemption, and resumption. It tracks per-rank token memory footprints in real time, uses semaphores to control KV cache preemption priority, and actively pins KV caches for multi-turn tasks expected to resume soon, eliminating redundant prefill overhead from cache eviction during idle periods; 2) Resource-Aware Ref-Actor Pipelining (RA²P), which abandons fixed ref-actor execution modes on training nodes and dynamically switches between two modes based on current ready backlog size and data arrival interval: decoupled streaming mode places ref and actor on separate GPUs for large backlogs and fast arrival to avoid weight swapping thrashing, while colocated aggregation mode lets ref and actor share GPU memory for small backlogs and slow arrival to reduce cross-node communication. It also overlaps ref inference and actor gradient computation at the micro-batch level to eliminate idle bubbles; 3) Elastic Resource Scaling (ERS), which treats individual data parallel ranks as schedulable resources instead of statically assigning them to rollout or training groups. The system monitors the source of current goodput loss in real time (insufficient rollout throughput or backlogged training data) and dynamically migrates GPU ranks between rollout and training pools to adapt to shifting bottlenecks.
summary_en.experiments: Based on the currently disclosed content, quantified baseline bottlenecks of existing systems are confirmed: static ref-actor scheduling leaves GPUs idle for up to 81% of per-step training time; redundant prefill computation from KV cache eviction grows linearly with multi-turn context length. Full experimental results of TideRL (including goodput improvement magnitude, resource utilization changes, end-to-end training time reduction, etc.) are not included in the provided full-text fragment.
summary_en.reading_guide: For close reading, first focus on paragraphs 5-7 of Introduction for the precise quantification and breakdown of three core bottlenecks — this section clearly articulates unaddressed pain points of current RL frameworks and forms the core motivation of the system design. Then dive into the design details of the three core components: CTB's task-level KV cache management mechanism, RA²P's mode switching conditions, and ERS's bottleneck judgment logic, which constitute the core innovations. If the full experimental section is available, prioritize goodput comparison across different workloads (single-turn vs. multi-turn, varying task complexity distributions), resource utilization curves, and ablation studies measuring the marginal gain of each individual component. Pay special attention to the "shared readiness view" abstraction, which is the foundation of cross-component coordinated decision-making.

recommendation.zh: 必须看系统分解和消融；它把 agentic RL 的瓶颈从 GPU occupancy 改写成 readiness/goodput，应尽快对照内部 RL pipeline。
recommendation.en: Read the system breakdown and ablations; it reframes agentic RL bottlenecks as readiness/goodput issues and should be checked against internal RL pipelines.

paper.title: Trajectory-Relative Hindsight Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Recent agentic reinforcement learning methods use hindsight to complement sparse outcome rewards. However, a completed rollout can yield many such signals, leaving their appropriate allocation across turns unclear. We introduce TRIAL, a trajectory-relative hindsight distillation framework with a unified turn-aligned scoring protocol. For each decision turn, TRIAL extracts an outcome view of that decision's realized consequence and evaluates the same response under ordinary and hindsight-conditio

summary.core_problem: TRIAL 解决的是 agentic RL 中稀疏结果奖励和多轮决策之间的信用分配问题。一次完整 rollout 只有最终成功或失败信号，但轨迹里包含多个决策 turn。已有 hindsight distillation 能给每个已执行动作构造事后监督，却没有清楚回答一个问题：这些 dense hindsight 信号应该在不同 turn 之间如何分配强度。
summary.importance: 这项工作和预训练训练流程的关系较间接，但对 RL 后训练、长程 agent 训练和 verifier/reward 信号设计有启发。它把 hindsight 信号拆成两个层次：token 级别的方向由 log-prob gap 决定，turn 级别的权重由整条轨迹内的相对 revision magnitude 决定。这个设计比简单给所有 hindsight token 同权更稳，因为它控制了平均权重，同时允许关键 turn 获得更大训练强度。对需要把长程交互数据转成可训练监督信号的系统，这是一种可复用的 credit allocation recipe。
summary.technical_approach: TRIAL 保留 GRPO 的 rollout-level outcome advantage 和 clipping 规则，在此基础上加入一个训练时 hindsight objective。对每个决策 turn，方法构造一个 outcome view，把该决策实际导致的局部后果暴露给 scorer。然后用同一个已生成 response，在 ordinary context 和 hindsight-conditioned context 下分别计算 token log probability。两者的有符号差值决定 token 更新方向和局部强度。接着，TRIAL 汇总每个 turn 内 eligible tokens 的绝对 gap，并和该 turn 在整条轨迹中的 eligible-token 占比比较，得到 trajectory-relative allocation multiplier。这些 multiplier 的 eligible-token 加权平均值被归一为 1，因此它是在固定平均训练强度下重新分配 hindsight 监督。最后，dense hindsight loss 与 GRPO loss 结合，并用相对 detached GRPO loss magnitude 的 scalar clamp 控制 dense 项强度。所有 hindsight context 和分配 profile 只在训练时使用，部署时不增加推理开销。
summary.experiments: 实验在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 上进行，backbone 包括 Qwen2.5-3B 和 Qwen3-1.7B。TRIAL 在 backbone、环境和指标组成的 8 个组合中都优于 GRPO；和 5 个 baseline 比较时，在 6 个 case 中最好或并列最好。WebShop 上使用 Qwen3-1.7B 时，success rate 从 GRPO 的 56.4% 提升到 75.2%，task score 从 78.7% 提升到 85.7%。消融实验固定 hindsight pathway，只替换 turn allocation profile。trajectory-relative profile 在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 的 4 个指标上都优于 unit profile，说明收益不只是来自 dense hindsight distillation，还来自轨迹内相对权重分配。source-shuffled profile 的对照也支持 profile 和真实轨迹结构相关，而不是简单噪声正则化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Method 中对 signed token gap、eligible-token mask、turn-level magnitude 和 trajectory-normalized multiplier 的定义；这是全文核心。再看 Figure 2，理解 GRPO outcome supervision 和 TRIAL hindsight supervision 如何并行工作。实验部分重点看 WebShop/Qwen3-1.7B 的提升，以及 unit profile、source-shuffled profile 的消融。若关注 RL 训练稳定性，可以额外看 dense loss clamp 的处理方式，它反映了作者在不破坏 GRPO advantage construction 的前提下加入辅助信号的取舍。

summary_en.core_problem: TRIAL addresses credit allocation in agentic reinforcement learning. A multi-turn rollout usually receives a sparse final outcome reward, but the trajectory contains many decisions made under different observations. Hindsight distillation can provide dense supervision for realized actions, yet it leaves open how much of that supervision should be assigned to each turn.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant to RL post-training and long-horizon agent training rather than pretraining itself. Its useful idea is to separate token-level revision direction from turn-level allocation. The signed log-probability gap gives local token supervision, while a trajectory-relative profile decides which turns deserve more weight. This is a practical recipe for converting long interaction traces into calibrated training signals without simply giving every hindsight token the same weight.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRIAL keeps the GRPO rollout-level advantage and clipping rule unchanged, then adds a training-only hindsight objective. For each decision turn, it builds an outcome view that exposes the realized local consequence of that decision. The same generated response is scored under the ordinary interaction context and under the hindsight-conditioned context. The signed token-level log-probability gap determines update direction and local revision strength. TRIAL then aggregates absolute gaps within each turn and compares a turn’s share of total revision magnitude with its share of eligible tokens. This yields a trajectory-relative allocation multiplier. The multipliers are normalized so their eligible-token-weighted mean is one, which redistributes hindsight supervision while keeping the average allocation fixed. A scalar clamp bounds the dense loss contribution relative to the detached GRPO loss magnitude. Hindsight contexts, discrepancy scores, and allocation profiles are used only during training, so inference uses the ordinary policy.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use WebShop and ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen3-1.7B. TRIAL improves over GRPO in all eight combinations of model, environment, and metric, and is best or tied best among six methods in six cases. On WebShop with Qwen3-1.7B, success rate increases from 56.4% to 75.2%, and task score increases from 78.7% to 85.7%. Controlled ablations keep the hindsight pathway fixed and vary only the allocation profile. The trajectory-relative profile outperforms a unit profile on all four WebShop and ALFWorld metrics, showing that the gains are not just from dense hindsight supervision. The source-shuffled profile comparison further suggests that the allocation profile benefits from being aligned with the actual trajectory structure.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Focus on the method definitions for signed token gaps, eligible-token masks, turn-level magnitudes, and trajectory-normalized multipliers. Figure 2 is the quickest way to understand how TRIAL complements GRPO rather than replacing it. In the experiments, prioritize the WebShop result with Qwen3-1.7B and the ablations comparing trajectory-relative, unit, and source-shuffled profiles. For readers interested in RL training stability, the loss clamp is worth checking because it shows how the auxiliary dense signal is constrained without changing GRPO’s advantage construction.

recommendation.zh: hindsight奖励分配的实用改进，对做agent RL或推理RL的研究员有参考，重点看§3的评分协议设计。
recommendation.en: Practical improvement for hindsight reward allocation, useful for researchers working on agent RL or reasoning RL, focus on the scoring protocol in §3.

Existing methods, however, do not jointly calibrate teacher scores across interaction steps

summary.core_problem: 多轮语言智能体的 RL 训练中，轨迹级奖励过于稀疏，无法定位到具体 token 或步骤的贡献，且现有自蒸馏奖励塑形缺乏跨步骤校准与回报关联。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出一种 token 级信用分配框架，把特权技能教师的打分与实际回报关联起来，用于 agentic RL 的 reward shaping。
summary.technical_approach: ADRS 用同一冻结策略快照在任务匹配的 procedural skill 条件下对无技能轨迹的固定 token 重打分；在每个交互步骤内做中心化和归一化，再用基于组内置信度-回报相关性的 Teacher Value Advantage (TVA) 门控调制，最后接入原生 reward-to-advantage 构造。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集或数字结果，仅描述框架设计；无法判断是否 SOTA 或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国科学技术大学与阿里巴巴集团；阿里巴巴在通义千问及 Agent/RL 方向有持续投入，但摘要未披露具体团队或知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-turn LLM agent RL, trajectory-level rewards are too sparse to assign credit to specific tokens or steps, and existing self-distilled reward shaping lacks cross-step calibration and return association.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: a token-level credit assignment framework that ties privileged-skill teacher scores to realized returns for agentic RL reward shaping.
summary_en.technical_approach: ADRS uses the same frozen policy snapshot, conditioned on task-matched procedural skills, to rescore fixed tokens from skill-free trajectories; it center-normalizes privileged token scores within each step, modulates them with a Teacher Value Advantage (TVA) gate based on within-group confidence–return correlation, and feeds the result into native reward-to-advantage construction.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides no model sizes, datasets, or quantitative results, so SOTA status or improvement magnitude cannot be assessed.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from USTC and Alibaba Group; Alibaba has ongoing work on Qwen, agents, and RL, but the abstract does not identify a specific team or well-known author.

recommendation.zh: 思路是把 process reward 做成 return-conditioned 的 token 级 advantage，方向对但摘要无实验，先记 TVA 这个设计，等正文表格再判断。
recommendation.en: Turning process rewards into return-conditioned token-level advantages is the right move, but the abstract has no experiments; note the TVA design and wait for tables.

paper.title: Cross-Domain Hybrid OPD for Generalizable Search Agents
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning (RL) have substantially improved the capabilities of autonomous search agents, enabling sophisticated planning, and iterative retrieval over dynamic information sources. However, optimizing language models for specialized search behaviors often incurs an alignment tax, where gains in search performance come at the expense of general-purpose capabilities, limiting their effectiveness as universal assistants. In this technical report, we present the traini

summary.core_problem: 面向搜索 agent 的强化学习会带来明显的能力偏移：搜索/规划/迭代检索能力提升的同时，通用指令遵循、对话、一般推理与生成能力出现退化。论文要解决的是如何在获得搜索专业化能力的同时，不付出这种通用能力对齐税。
summary.importance: 这是一篇工业界技术报告，核心价值不在提出新的训练算法，而在于给出一个"specialized RL 后接跨域专家 OPD 回补通用能力"的完整 recipe，对 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口问题有参考价值：定向 RL 阶段会对基座能力造成怎样的分布偏移，以及如何通过多教师在线蒸馏在不覆盖新习得策略的前提下恢复/增强通用能力。对基座研究者更有意义的是其中关于"能力不是零和，关键是不要让专门化训练覆盖通用先验"的判断，以及多域教师混合蒸馏的工程实践。
summary.technical_approach: 训练框架基于 Hunyuan3 底座，分两阶段。第一阶段做 agentic RL，训练模型在动态信息源上进行自主规划、迭代检索、证据驱动推理等搜索行为。第二阶段做 cross-domain hybrid OPD：分别在数学、代码、逻辑推理、科学四个域构建大规模语料（公开 benchmark + 内部筛选/合成数据），训练对应的 expert teachers，然后用这些跨域专家做在线策略蒸馏，把多域通用推理与知识能力迁移回搜索特化后的模型。训练中还引入了按经验成功率划分的难度课程：数学/代码分 easy/medium/hard 三档，逻辑/科学分 medium/hard 两档，用于教师训练和 RL 课程。整体设计上，不是简单 SFT 回灌通用数据来修补 RL 损伤，而是在 RL 得到搜索策略后，用多专家 OPD 在学生自身访问的状态分布上注入通用能力，尽量避免把搜索策略覆盖掉。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的是 Yuanbao search agent 的整体训练方案报告。数据侧，四个专家域的训练语料覆盖 MATH、GSM8K、AQuA-RAT、APPS、LiveCodeBench、SynLogic、BBH、SciBench、SciQ、GPQA 等公开集，并配合内部构建/合成数据扩充长尾推理场景；训练侧使用 reference policy 的采样成功率将题目分 difficulty bucket 作为课程。主结论是混合训练后的模型在搜索 benchmark 上保持有竞争力的表现，同时在通用能力评测上相对 Hunyuan3 基座整体提升，说明搜索专门化和通用能力可以在该流程下同时改善而非互相抵消。论文为技术报告风格，消融和具体数值细节在节选内容里披露有限。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 Introduction 与框架图里对 search RL 导致的 alignment tax 的刻画、整体两阶段 pipeline 的设计逻辑，以及数据/课程部分对多域专家教师数据构成和难度划分的描述。对 pretrain 读者，最值得看的是：专门化 RL 造成的通用能力损伤模式、为什么他们选择 OPD 而不是纯 SFT 回补、多教师混合时如何避免把新学的搜索策略洗掉。不需要抠具体 benchmark 数字，更多是把它当作一个工业界"特化 RL + 通用能力回填"的案例来读。
summary.authors_note: 腾讯元宝/Hunyuan 团队技术报告，基于 Hunyuan3 架构训练 Yuanbao 搜索 agent。

summary_en.core_problem: Reinforcement learning for autonomous search agents produces strong retrieval, planning, and multi-step search behaviors, but also induces capability drift: instruction following, conversational quality, general reasoning, and open-ended generation can degrade. The report targets how to obtain search specialization without paying that generic-capability alignment tax.
summary_en.importance: This is an industry technical report rather than a new algorithmic contribution. Its value lies in presenting a complete recipe of specialized agent RL followed by cross-domain expert on-policy distillation to restore and enhance general capabilities, which is directly relevant to the pretrain/posttrain interface: how targeted RL shifts distribution away from generic priors, and how multi-teacher OPD can inject broad capabilities without overwriting the newly acquired specialized policy. The useful claim for foundation-model researchers is that specialization and generalization need not be traded off if the post-RL capability-recovery stage is designed carefully, especially by using on-policy distillation on the student’s own state distribution instead of blunt supervised recovery.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework is built on Hunyuan3 and consists of two stages. First, agentic RL trains autonomous search behaviors such as planning, iterative retrieval, and evidence-based reasoning over dynamic environments. Second, cross-domain hybrid OPD is applied: large corpora are built for four domains—mathematics, coding, logical reasoning, and science—combining public benchmarks with internally curated or synthesized data; domain-specific expert teachers are trained on these corpora; then those teachers distill into the search-specialized model via on-policy distillation, transferring broad reasoning and knowledge capabilities while preserving the learned search policy. Difficulty-aware curriculum is used in teacher training and RL: problems are bucketed by empirical success rate of a reference policy into easy/medium/hard for math and coding, and medium/hard for logic and science. The design intentionally avoids naive post-RL SFT on generic data, which risks overwriting the search policy, and instead uses multi-expert OPD on states visited by the student.
summary_en.experiments: The paper is presented as a technical report for the Yuanbao search agent. On the data side, four expert-domain corpora cover public benchmarks including MATH, GSM8K, AQuA-RAT, APPS, LiveCodeBench, SynLogic, BBH, SciBench, SciQ, and GPQA, supplemented by internal/synthesized data for long-tail reasoning scenarios. On the training side, a reference policy’s sampling success rate is used to assign difficulty buckets and drive curriculum learning. The main reported outcome is that the resulting search agent remains highly competitive on search benchmarks while improving over the Hunyuan3 base model on a broad set of general-purpose evaluations, supporting the claim that search specialization and general capability can be improved jointly rather than traded off. Detailed ablations and precise numbers are limited in the excerpted material.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Focus on the introduction and pipeline figure for their characterization of the alignment tax from search-oriented RL, the two-stage design logic, and the data/curriculum section describing multi-domain teacher corpora and difficulty bucketing. For a pretrain-oriented reader, the most useful parts are the failure mode induced by specialized RL, why OPD is preferred over plain SFT-based recovery, and how multi-teacher distillation is arranged to avoid overwriting the newly learned search policy. There is little need to dwell on exact benchmark scores; treat it as an industrial case study on specialized RL plus capability recovery.
summary_en.authors_note: Tencent Yuanbao / Hunyuan team technical report on the Yuanbao search agent, built on Hunyuan3.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 OPD 训练闭环和退化评测；若通用能力集不干净，结论只能当产品级信号。
recommendation.en: Read the OPD loop and degradation eval; if the general-skill set is leaky, treat the claim as product evidence.

paper.title: Scaling Scientific Discovery Environments for Turn-Level Agentic RL
paper.abstract: Large language model agents have shown promising capabilities in data-driven scientific discovery tasks, where an agent interacts with an execution environment and produces a statistical claim. Long-horizon scientific analysis remains constrained by the lack of process supervised environments over real-world scientific data. This paper introduces SciDisco, a scalable framework for training Scientific Discovery agents in process-verifiable environments. SciThèque compiles hypotheses, datasets, hi

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是科学数据分析 Agent 的训练接口问题：真实科学数据很多，但通常只有静态数据文件，缺少可执行环境、可验证目标和跨 turn 的过程监督。结果是 Agent 只能靠提示词或通用多轮数据学习分析流程，很难学到什么时候查数据、什么时候选统计方法、什么时候修正假设、什么时候提交结论。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在基座训练配方，而在 post-train 训练信号设计。SciDisco 把科学发现任务改造成可执行、可验证、可给过程奖励的环境，这对 agentic RL 很关键。它强调的不是最终答案奖励，而是 turn-level credit assignment：每一步是否产生了可验证的分析证据。这个思路对代码 Agent、数据分析 Agent、长程工具使用 RL 都有参考价值，尤其适合思考如何从环境中构造更密集、更可信的训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三层。第一层是 SciThèque，把开放科学数据集编译成带有 hypothesis、dataset、sandbox execution 和 verifier 的任务环境。环境对 Agent 暴露任务目标和数据，并执行代码动作；任务内部保留 hidden evidence DAG，用来描述从数据理解到统计证据再到最终结论的可验证路径。第二层是 DAG-grounded trajectory synthesis，用 hidden evidence DAG 合成多轮演示轨迹，并通过 verifier 过滤，作为 SFT 冷启动数据。这样做是为了避免 RL 初期大量无效工具调用和错误变量读取。第三层是 DiscoPO，用环境反馈给每个 turn 分配过程奖励，而不是只在最后提交答案时给稀疏奖励。核心区别在于，任务构造、SFT 数据生成和 RL 过程奖励都共享同一个 evidence DAG 接口，减少了演示数据和在线优化目标之间的不一致。
summary.experiments: 给定内容主要覆盖问题定义和方法设计，没有提供完整实验表、性能数字或消融结果。可确认的实验相关设定包括：任务被建模为 POMDP，Agent 与每个科学发现环境多轮交互；动作包括可执行分析和终止提交；奖励从最终稀疏奖励扩展为 turn-level process reward。真正需要看的实验应包括 DiscoPO 相比纯 prompt、SFT、final-reward RL 的收益，DAG 合成轨迹的冷启动效果，以及 process verifier 对长程分析成功率的影响。但具体参数量、任务规模和提升幅度在提供内容中不可见。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Problem Formulation 中把科学发现写成 POMDP 和过程奖励目标的部分，以及 Methodology 中 hidden evidence DAG 如何同时服务于任务构建、轨迹合成和 RL 奖励。若只能看一处，优先看 SciThèque 与 DiscoPO 的接口设计。对基座研究员来说，最值得深挖的是 verifier 能否稳定表达“有效分析进展”，以及这种 verifier 是否会诱导 Agent 学会迎合检查器而不是真正改进分析能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a training-interface problem for scientific data-analysis agents. Open scientific datasets are abundant, but they usually do not come with executable task environments, verifiable goals, or process-level supervision across turns. As a result, agents trained with prompts or generic multi-turn traces often fail to learn robust policies for inspecting data, choosing statistical methods, revising analyses, and submitting evidence-backed claims.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to foundation-model research is not a pretraining recipe, but the design of post-training signals for agentic RL. SciDisco turns scientific discovery into an executable and verifiable environment where reward can be assigned at the turn level. This is useful for thinking about long-horizon tool-use training: the training signal should identify which intermediate actions produced valid evidence, rather than rewarding only the final answer. The same design pattern is applicable to coding agents, data-analysis agents, and other environments where sparse outcome rewards are too weak.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline has three components. SciThèque compiles open scientific datasets into hypothesis-driven environments with sandboxed code execution and task-specific verifiers. Each task contains a hidden evidence DAG that represents verifiable analytical progress toward the target finding. DAG-grounded trajectory synthesis uses this structure to generate multi-turn demonstrations and filters them through the verifier, providing a behavioral prior before RL. DiscoPO then optimizes the policy using process feedback from the environment, assigning credit to turns that advance the hidden evidence state. The key design choice is that task construction, SFT trajectory generation, and online RL credit assignment all share the same evidence-DAG interface.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied content covers the formulation and method, but does not include complete experimental tables, numerical results, or ablations. The confirmed setup models each task as a POMDP: the agent receives the hypothesis and dataset, interacts through executable actions, observes environment feedback, and eventually submits a claim. Reward is extended from a sparse final signal to turn-level process rewards. The missing but important experimental evidence would be comparisons against prompting, SFT-only training, and final-reward RL, plus ablations on DAG-grounded demonstrations and process verification.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the POMDP and process-reward formulation, then read the SciThèque and DiscoPO interface design. The most useful part for pretraining and post-training researchers is the hidden evidence DAG: how it defines valid progress, how it supports synthetic demonstrations, and how it becomes a reward source during online RL. The main question to keep in mind is whether the verifier captures real analytical progress or merely creates a new target for reward hacking.

recommendation.zh: 可过程验证环境比最终答案 RL 更接近可扩展监督；只看 SciThèque/DiscoPO 设计和 verifier 噪声处理。
recommendation.en: Process-verifiable environments are closer to scalable supervision than final-answer RL; focus on SciThèque, DiscoPO, and how verifier noise is handled.

paper.title: Graph Is the Verifier: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Interprocedural Vulnerability Detection
paper.abstract: Real-world vulnerabilities often span multiple functions, yet most learning-based detectors classify each function in isolation: on a sample of real CVEs, we find that 71.7% of vulnerable functions require evidence from outside the function to be classified correctly. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) could close this gap by enabling a model to gather that evidence itself, but it lacks a reliable reward, since a reward defined on the final verdict alone can be obtained without performing any i

summary.core_problem: 现有漏洞检测多按函数孤立分类，71.7%的真实漏洞函数需要函数外证据才能正确分类，且agentic RL缺乏可靠奖励信号。
summary.importance: 代码安全领域的agent+RL应用，用代码属性图作为奖励验证器，对RL奖励设计有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出VulAgentRL，基于代码属性图(CPG)构建agentic RL框架，CPG既作为推理时查询源，又作为训练时证据验证器，通过节点ID精确比较提供精确奖励。
summary.experiments: 在真实CVE样本上验证，71.7%的漏洞函数需要跨函数证据；未披露具体模型规模和基线对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Most vulnerability detectors classify functions in isolation, while 71.7% of real vulnerable functions require cross-function evidence, and agentic RL lacks reliable reward signals.
summary_en.importance: Code security application of agent + RL, using code property graphs as reward verifiers, with some reference value for RL reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes VulAgentRL, an agentic RL framework built on Code Property Graphs (CPG), where CPG serves as both inference-time query source and training-time evidence verifier, providing precise rewards via node ID comparison.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on real CVE samples where 71.7% of vulnerable functions require cross-function evidence; specific model scale and baseline comparison not disclosed in abstract.

recommendation.zh: 特定领域代码agent应用，CPG做奖励验证的思路对RL奖励设计有微弱启发，不值得深读。
recommendation.en: Domain-specific coding agent application; CPG as reward verifier has minor RL design inspiration, not worth deep reading.

paper.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
paper.abstract: We introduce Kimi K3, a 2.8T parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 104 billion activated parameters, native vision capabilities, and a 1-million-token context window. Kimi K3 is built on Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, which improve information flow across sequence length and model depth. Together with Stable LatentMoE, which effectively activates 16 of 896 routed experts per token, and refined training and data recipes, these advances yield an approximately 2.5x improvement in o

summary.core_problem: Kimi K3 试图解决的是一个更完整的前沿基座问题：当开源模型已经普遍把重心放到 test-time scaling、RL 和推理链条上时，预训练底座本身仍停留在 1T 左右参数级别，导致后续 RL 和 agentic post-training 的上限被基础容量、长上下文信息流和训练稳定性共同限制。K3 的目标不是单点改进，而是在 2.8T 级别 MoE、1M context、原生多模态和长轨迹 RL 这几个维度同时推进，并且把这些维度做成一个能训练、能对齐、能部署的统一系统。
summary.importance: 这篇技术报告对预训练研究的价值很高，主要因为它给出了一个 3T-class 开源底座如何被真正训练出来的较完整配方。重要性有三层。第一，它不是单纯堆参数，而是把长序列建模、深层信息流、极稀疏 MoE 稳定性、数据与训练 recipe 放在一起，声称相对 Kimi K2 获得约 2.5× 的整体 scaling efficiency 提升，这对大模型 scaling 研究是实打实的信号。第二，它把 pretrain 和 post-train 明确连成闭环：预训练底座为 1M context 的 agentic RL 服务，而 RL 又通过多 effort level、多教师 on-policy distillation 回灌到统一模型。第三，它展示了前沿模型里 architecture、systems、RL infrastructure 已经很难分开看；如果只研究其中一个局部，往往解释不了最终能力和成本曲线。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线可以拆成四块。第一块是长上下文与深层信息流。Kimi Delta Attention 负责长序列混合，周期性插入 Gated MLA 层保留全局交互；这说明他们没有完全放弃 attention，而是用更便宜的序列混合主干配合稀疏的全局 attention 校正。Attention Residuals 则让每层可以选择性访问所有前层表示，缓解超深网络中的信息衰减与优化困难。第二块是超大规模稀疏 MoE。K3 使用 Stable LatentMoE，把 routed expert 空间扩到 896 个，每个 token 激活 16 个 expert，外加 shared expert。这里的难点不是 MoE 结构本身，而是极高稀疏度下的训练稳定性与负载均衡。报告提到用 normalization、SiTU-GLU 和 Quantile Balancing 来稳定路由与激活分布，目标是既扩大专家容量，又避免 router collapse、负载失衡和训练震荡。第三块是训练与数据 recipe。公开文本里没有把所有数据细节完全展开，但明确把 refined data and training recipes 作为 2.5× scaling efficiency 的组成部分，而不是把收益全部归因于架构。这一点很重要，因为大模型报告常把数据因素弱化。第四块是 post-training 与基础设施协同。RL 覆盖 general、agentic、coding 和多种 reasoning effort level，训练环境包括可验证搜索、专业知识工作、软件工程、kernel optimization、vision-in-the-loop 工具使用、persistent assistant workflow 等。不同领域和 effort 的策略最后通过 multi-teacher on-policy distillation 合并到统一模型。系统侧则分别为 KDA、2.8T MoE 预训练、百万 token agentic RL 和 serving 做了专门设计：如 fused kernels、KDA context parallelism、state-aware prefix caching、MoonEP 的静态 shape 与零拷贝通信、外部 KV 保留、partial rollout、可恢复 microVM sandbox 等。这里最值得注意的是，他们把“能否训练和运行长轨迹 RL”当成模型设计的一部分，而不是后处理问题。
summary.experiments: 从报告给出的关键信息看，模型规模是 2.8T total parameters、104B activated parameters、1M token context，并且是 native vision model。作者声称相对 Kimi K2，整体 scaling efficiency 提升约 2.5×。这个数字不是单一 benchmark 提升，而是综合 architecture、MoE 稳定化、数据和训练 recipe 后，在同等计算下获得更好能力或在同等能力下节省计算。评测覆盖 long-horizon coding、agentic、knowledge、reasoning 和 vision，多数公开对比里 Kimi K3 整体落后于最强闭源系统 Claude Fable 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol，但稳定领先其余被纳入套件的开源与闭源模型。对预训练研究者更有价值的不是榜单名次，而是几个结构性信号：一，16-of-896 这种极稀疏激活在 104B active 规模上仍可稳定训练；二，1M context 不是只靠推理时外插，而是与架构和 RL 轨迹长度一起设计；三，多 effort RL 与 agentic 训练被视为统一模型能力的一部分，而非单独外挂。若全文中有更细的消融，重点应看 KDA 与 Gated MLA 的配比、AttnRes 对深层训练稳定性的影响、Stable LatentMoE 相比常规 top-k MoE 的负载与 loss 曲线、以及数据 recipe 对 scaling curve 的贡献拆分。
summary.reading_guide: 精读建议按三条线走。第一条线看架构章节和总览图，先搞清 KDA、Gated MLA、AttnRes、Stable LatentMoE 在 block 内如何组合，尤其要看为什么长序列 mixing、全局 attention 和跨层残差要同时存在，而不是只押一个机制。第二条线看训练与系统章节，重点找 2.8T MoE 的稳定性细节：router 设计、负载均衡、激活分布、并行策略、MoonEP 的静态 shape 与通信路径。这部分对真正做大规模预训练最有参考价值。第三条线看 post-training 与 RL infrastructure，关注 1M context 长轨迹是如何被环境、缓存和 rollout 机制支撑起来的，以及 multi-teacher on-policy distillation 如何把多 effort policy 合并。图表上优先看 scaling efficiency 对比、长上下文能力曲线、MoE 负载统计、以及 RL 训练后不同任务簇的收益。若时间有限，先读 Introduction、architecture overview、systems/pretraining sections，再挑 RL consolidation 部分。完整读下来大约需要 1.5 到 2.5 小时，因为它不是单一方法论文，而是一个大系统的技术说明。
summary.authors_note: Moonshot AI / Kimi 团队技术报告。公开署名通常为 Kimi Research 或 Moonshot AI 多作者协作，核心背景是长上下文、MoE、agentic RL 与系统联合设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Kimi K3 addresses a broader frontier problem than a single architectural tweak. Open models have recently advanced quickly in test-time scaling, RL, and reasoning, but many pretraining foundations remain around the 1T-parameter regime. That limits the ceiling of downstream RL and agentic training. K3 aims to push several constraints at once: a 2.8T-class MoE foundation, 1M-token context, native multimodality, and long-horizon RL, while keeping the whole stack trainable and deployable.
summary_en.importance: This report matters because it provides a relatively complete recipe for how an open 3T-class foundation is actually built. Its importance comes in three layers. First, it is not just parameter scaling. The report combines long-sequence modeling, deep information flow, extremely sparse MoE stabilization, and data/training recipe refinements, and attributes an overall ~2.5x scaling-efficiency gain over Kimi K2 to that combination. That is directly relevant to scaling-law and systems-aware pretraining research. Second, it treats pretraining and post-training as one loop: the foundation is designed for 1M-context agentic RL, and RL capabilities are later consolidated back into a unified model through multi-teacher on-policy distillation. Third, it shows that at this scale, architecture, infrastructure, and RL systems cannot be studied in isolation if one wants to understand the final capability-cost tradeoff.
summary_en.technical_approach: The technical design has four major pieces. First is long-context and deep information flow. Kimi Delta Attention serves as the main long-sequence mixing mechanism, while Gated MLA layers are periodically interleaved to preserve global interaction. This suggests they do not fully abandon attention; instead they use a cheaper sequence-mixing backbone plus sparse global correction. Attention Residuals let each layer selectively access representations from all previous layers, which is meant to reduce information decay and optimization difficulty in very deep networks. Second is ultra-large sparse MoE. K3 uses Stable LatentMoE with 896 routed experts and 16 activated experts per token, plus shared experts. The challenge here is not the MoE idea itself but stable optimization and balanced routing under extreme sparsity. The report highlights normalization, SiTU-GLU, and Quantile Balancing as the stabilizers that keep routing and activation distributions under control. Third is the training and data recipe. The public text does not fully expose all data details, but it explicitly includes refined data and training recipes as part of the claimed efficiency gain rather than attributing everything to architecture. That is an important signal. Fourth is post-training and infrastructure co-design. RL spans general reasoning, agentic tasks, coding, and multiple reasoning-effort levels. Training environments include verifiable search, professional knowledge work, software engineering, kernel optimization, multimodal tool use, persistent assistant workflows, and autonomous execution. These specialized policies are later merged through multi-teacher on-policy distillation. On the systems side, the report introduces fused kernels, KDA context parallelism, state-aware prefix caching, MoonEP for perfectly balanced expert execution with static shapes and zero-copy communication, plus external KV retention, partial rollouts, and resumable microVM sandboxes for million-token agentic RL. A notable design choice is that long-horizon RL support is treated as part of the model stack, not as an afterthought.
summary_en.experiments: The key reported scales are 2.8T total parameters, 104B activated parameters, 1M-token context, and native vision capability. The headline claim is an approximately 2.5x improvement in overall scaling efficiency over Kimi K2. This is not a single benchmark delta; it is presented as a combined effect of architecture, MoE stabilization, and refined data/training recipes. Evaluation spans long-horizon coding, agentic tasks, knowledge, reasoning, and vision. In the authors’ benchmark suite, Kimi K3 trails the strongest proprietary systems, Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, but is reported to be consistently ahead of the other open and proprietary models included there. For pretraining researchers, the more important signals are structural: 16-of-896 sparse activation appears trainable at 104B active scale; 1M context is designed jointly with architecture and RL trajectory length rather than treated as pure inference extrapolation; and multi-effort RL is integrated into the unified model rather than exposed as a separate specialist policy. If the full report contains detailed ablations, the most valuable ones to inspect are the KDA versus Gated MLA mix, the effect of Attention Residuals on optimization at depth, the load and loss behavior of Stable LatentMoE versus standard top-k MoE, and the contribution of data recipe changes to the scaling curve.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it along three tracks. First, study the architecture overview and block diagrams to understand how KDA, Gated MLA, Attention Residuals, and Stable LatentMoE are composed, and why the design keeps all three forms of information flow: along sequence length, across depth, and across expert width. Second, read the pretraining and systems sections carefully, especially the details around MoE stability, routing balance, parallelism, MoonEP, and communication design. That is where much of the practical value lies for anyone training very large sparse models. Third, read the post-training and RL infrastructure sections to see how million-token trajectories are made feasible and how multi-effort policies are consolidated. Prioritize figures on scaling efficiency, long-context performance, MoE load statistics, and RL gains by task family. If time is limited, start with the introduction, architecture overview, and pretraining/systems sections, then sample the RL consolidation part. A full careful read likely takes 1.5 to 2.5 hours because this is a large-stack technical report rather than a narrow method paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Moonshot AI / Kimi technical report. Public authorship is typically listed under Kimi Research or a large Moonshot AI collaboration, with background spanning long-context modeling, sparse MoE training, agentic RL, and systems co-design.

recommendation.zh: 国内一线 MoE 旗舰的训练与 RL 基建披露，KDA+LatentMoE+百万 token agentic RL 的组合值得对照自家 scaling 表和路由稳定性实验马上复现思路。
recommendation.en: A flagship MoE report from a top Chinese lab; cross-check their KDA + LatentMoE + 1M-token agentic RL stack against your own scaling tables and routing stability ablations right away.

paper.title: Hybrid Advantage Estimation with Unified Critic for VLM Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) now act as agents in interactive environments, where success requires coherent reasoning and decision-making across turns. Although end-to-end training in agentic environments can improve such multi-turn decision-making abilities, current methods mainly rely on either token-wise optimization over concatenated token trajectories or turn-wise optimization with uniform within-turn credit. In this work, we establish theoretical formulations for the two levels of o

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 VLM 多轮 Agent 强化学习中的信用分配问题。现有方法通常在两种粒度之间二选一：token-wise RL 把每个 token 当作动作，适合细粒度语言生成；turn-wise RL 把一整轮输出当作动作，更容易利用环境反馈。但多轮任务同时需要轮内生成质量和跨轮策略调整，单一粒度容易造成训练信号不匹配。论文关注的典型失败是模型只看最近观察，忽略过去动作和失败反馈，反复输出已经失败的动作。
summary.importance: 这篇工作和基座预训练的关系主要在 post-train/RL 接口。它讨论的是如何把多轮环境反馈转成适合 VLM policy 更新的 advantage 信号。对于预训练研究者，启发点在于：当模型从静态指令学习进入交互式任务时，训练目标的粒度会影响模型是否学到长期状态更新，而不只是单轮响应风格。统一 token 和 turn 两种价值估计，也降低了多头 critic 或多套训练目标带来的系统复杂度。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先用 POMDP 形式化 VLM 多轮交互，把历史观察、动作、奖励和当前轮已生成 token 纳入状态历史。它分别推导 token-wise 和 turn-wise RL 的优化形式，并指出两者的策略梯度 surrogate 在结构上相同，关键差异集中在 advantage 估计。基于这个观察，论文提出 Hybrid Advantage Estimation：用线性组合同时融合 token 级和 turn 级 advantage，从而兼顾轮内 token 生成的细粒度学习和轮间环境反馈的策略学习。进一步地，论文说明在合适的折扣因子和学习目标选择下，同一个 critic 可以同时估计 token-wise value 和 turn-wise value，不需要为两种粒度维护完全独立的价值模型。最终方法 HyGAE 是一个 actor-critic 框架，训练 actor 时使用混合 advantage，训练 critic 时使用统一价值目标。论文还从偏差-方差角度解释混合估计为何比单一粒度更稳定。
summary.experiments: 论文在五个多轮决策 benchmark 上评估 HyGAE，并与多种 token-wise、turn-wise 以及层级式基线比较。报告的平均成功率为 0.91，在所比较方法中表现最好。消融结果显示，混合 advantage 的解析形式和 mixed return 的定义对稳定训练很关键；简单拼接或不精确地混合两种信号会削弱效果。定性分析展示了一个主要改进点：模型更能利用过去失败反馈调整后续动作，而不是在相似观察下重复错误输出。给定材料没有列出五个 benchmark 的名称、模型规模、训练数据量和逐项分数，精确数字需要查看实验表格。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中的失败案例，理解论文为什么认为 VLM Agent 存在 nearsightedness。然后看 Preliminaries 和方法部分的 POMDP 定义、token-wise/turn-wise surrogate 推导，重点是“二者差异主要落在 advantage 估计”这一点。方法部分需要关注 hybrid advantage 的线性组合、统一 critic 的折扣因子和学习目标设置。实验部分优先看主结果表、混合 advantage 和 mixed return 的消融，以及训练稳定性曲线。若只关心可复用价值，重点读公式推导和 ablation 即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses credit assignment in multi-turn VLM agent reinforcement learning. Current methods usually choose either token-wise RL, where every token is treated as an action, or turn-wise RL, where an entire response turn is treated as one action. Token-wise training gives fine-grained language-generation signals, while turn-wise training uses intermediate environment feedback more naturally. Multi-turn agents need both. The failure mode highlighted by the paper is myopic behavior: the model reacts to the latest observation, ignores previous failed actions and feedback, and repeats an unsuccessful output.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to foundation-model research is mainly through the post-training and RL interface. The paper studies how multi-turn feedback should be converted into advantage estimates for updating a VLM policy. The useful point is that the granularity of the RL objective changes what the model learns: single-turn response quality, within-turn token choice, or cross-turn strategy adaptation. A unified critic for both token-level and turn-level values can also simplify training compared with maintaining separate value models or loosely combining separate objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method starts from a POMDP formulation of VLM interaction, where the history includes observations, actions, rewards, and the prefix tokens generated in the current turn. The paper derives token-wise and turn-wise RL objectives and argues that their policy-gradient surrogates have the same gradient structure; the main difference lies in how the advantage is estimated. Based on this, it proposes Hybrid Advantage Estimation, a linear combination of token-level and turn-level advantages. This lets the policy receive fine-grained guidance for language generation and turn-level guidance from intermediate environment feedback. The paper further shows that, with a suitable discount factor and learning target, one critic can estimate both token-wise and turn-wise values. HyGAE instantiates this idea as an actor-critic algorithm, using the hybrid advantage for actor updates and a unified value target for critic training. The bias-variance discussion is used to motivate why the hybrid estimator can be more stable than either single-granularity estimator.
summary_en.experiments: HyGAE is evaluated on five multi-turn decision-making benchmarks against several token-wise, turn-wise, and hierarchical baselines. The reported average success rate is 0.91, the best among the compared methods. Ablations indicate that the exact analytic form of the hybrid advantage and the definition of the mixed return are important for stable optimization; naïve or imprecise mixing weakens performance. Qualitative analysis shows that the trained agent is better at using past failure feedback to change future actions instead of repeating the same failed response under similar observations. The provided text does not include the benchmark names, model sizes, training data scale, or per-task scores, so those details should be read from the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction and the failure example to understand the nearsightedness problem in VLM agents. Then read the POMDP setup and the derivation of token-wise and turn-wise surrogates, with attention to the claim that the main difference is advantage estimation. In the method section, focus on the hybrid advantage formula, the unified critic target, and the discount-factor choice. In the experiments, read the main result table, the ablations on hybrid advantage and mixed return, and any stability curves. For reuse, the most important parts are the derivation and the ablation evidence.

recommendation.zh: 读理论推导和 ablation 即可；若 unified critic 真稳，会影响多轮 RLVR 的 credit assignment 设计。
recommendation.en: Read the derivation and ablations; if the unified critic is actually stable, it is a useful signal for multi-turn RLVR credit assignment.

paper.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B: Unlocking Agentic Capabilities in a Compact Mode
paper.abstract: We present Nanbeige4.2-3B, a compact general agentic model with 3B non-embedding parameters. It delivers strong performance across code-agent, office-agent, and complex tool-use tasks while maintaining highly competitive reasoning capabilities in mathematics, coding, and science. Nanbeige4.2-3B is pretrained from scratch on 28T tokens with a Looped Transformer that reuses the layer stack to increase capacity without adding parameters. For SFT data and trajectory construction, we expand the diver

summary.core_problem: 在严格参数预算（3B）下，把“通用推理能力”和“跨环境的 agentic 能力”（代码仓库、办公文档、复杂工具调用、长轨迹纠错）同时做进一个模型：既要底座足够强，又要在后训练阶段学会稳定执行多步工具链与环境交互。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接启发点主要有两类：
- 架构/训练配方：Looped Transformer 通过重复使用同一层栈提高有效深度，提供一种在参数不变时用计算换容量的路线；论文还给出“从零训练 looped”优于“先训标准再 upcycle”的经验结论，以及 loop pass 数与 token efficiency/稳定性的取舍。
- Pretrain↔Posttrain 接口：在 28T token 从零预训练后，用大规模可执行环境轨迹做 SFT/RL，并引入 mixed-mode RLHF（Think/Non-Think）与长度控制 RL，属于把推理风格与 agent 失败模式当作可优化对象。
但整体更像一个系统性模型发布与工程总结：大量篇幅在 agent 数据与 RL pipeline，属于后训练与 agent 方向；如果只关心“基座预训练方法”，信息密度相对有限。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 架构：Looped Transformer。hidden states 通过共享的 Transformer 层栈跑多次（文中强调两次 pass 最合适），在不增加非 embedding 参数的情况下增加有效计算深度。
- 训练策略：对比两条路线：a) 标准 Transformer 预训练后再转 loop（upcycling）；b) 直接从零按 looped 架构预训练。结论是从零训练显著更好，原因是表示会在预训练早期就适配“层复用”的归纳偏置。
- loop 深度选择：两次 pass 在能力增益与训练代价之间最平衡；更多 pass 收益小但训练更慢且更不稳定。
- KV cache sharing：提出跨 pass 共享 KV 以减半 cache，但性能增益更低，最终选择不共享以保性能。
2) 预训练：28T tokens，从零训练 3B base；数据配比上提高数学、代码、合成 QA 权重（细节需要在数据章节核对具体比例与清洗策略）。
3) 后训练（与预训练关联较弱但占比大）：
- SFT：构建“真实环境 + 大规模合成环境”的混合池，在 repo 级软件工程、复杂工具使用、office 任务上生成可执行轨迹；用执行信号与 rubric 做轨迹/turn 级过滤。
- RL：多阶段：先 mixed-mode RLHF 同时覆盖 Think/Non-Think 以减少幻觉/重复/指令偏差；再做长度控制推理 RL 平衡简洁与探索；最后做 agentic RL，用 outcome+process reward 提供更密的 credit assignment，稳定长轨迹学习。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可确认的关键数字：
- 模型规模：3B non-embedding 参数。
- 预训练规模：28T tokens。
- 架构消融结论：从零训练 looped > upcycling；两次 pass 最优；KV cache sharing 降内存但带来更低性能增益。
性能方面，论文宣称在 code-agent、office-agent、复杂 tool-use 评测上超过更大模型（如 Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-12B），并保持数学/代码/科学推理竞争力；但在当前提供的正文片段里缺少具体表格数字与统计设置（评测基准、提示词、是否多次采样、agent 框架配置等），需要回到实验章节逐项核对，尤其是 agent 评测的可复现性与是否存在 scaffold 优势。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（45–60 分钟）：
- 如果关注预训练/架构：直接看 Pre-Training 小节里关于“from-scratch vs upcycling”“loop pass 数选择”“KV cache sharing”的实验结论与取舍。
- 如果关注 pretrain↔posttrain 接口：看 mixed-mode RLHF 与长度控制 RL 的动机与失败案例分类，理解它们在 agent 轨迹里解决什么具体问题。
- 实验部分建议先找：looped 架构的对照表、token efficiency 的定义与测量方式、以及 agent 评测是否控制了外部工具/框架差异。整体预计需要额外 30 分钟专门核对实验设置与数据构造细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Building a compact (3B) model that simultaneously retains strong general reasoning and supports broad agentic behaviors across heterogeneous executable environments (repo-level coding, office artifacts, complex tool use, long-horizon recovery), under a strict parameter budget.
summary_en.importance: Pretraining-relevant takeaways are mainly: (1) Looped Transformer as a compute-for-capacity approach under fixed parameters, with practical findings on how to train it; (2) an explicit pretrain→posttrain pipeline where large-scale executable trajectories and RL objectives target agent failure modes and reasoning length. Much of the paper is closer to an engineering/model release centered on agent data and RL; if the goal is purely new pretraining methodology, the incremental insight is moderate.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Architecture: a Looped Transformer that reuses the same Transformer stack for multiple passes over the hidden states. The paper emphasizes a two-pass configuration as the best trade-off.
Training findings:
- Training from scratch with the looped architecture outperforms upcycling (pretrain standard → convert to loop), suggesting representations should adapt to layer reuse early in pretraining.
- Increasing the number of passes yields diminishing returns while slowing training and hurting stability.
- KV-cache sharing across passes halves cache memory but reduces performance gains; they keep the full non-sharing loop.
Pretraining: 28T tokens from scratch; the data mixture increases math/code/synthetic QA weights (exact ratios/filters need verification in the full data section).
Post-training (dominant part): executable trajectory SFT from a hybrid pool of real + synthesized environments with execution/rubric filtering; multi-stage RL including mixed-mode RLHF over Think/Non-Think, length-controlled reasoning RL, and agentic RL with outcome + process rewards for denser credit assignment in long trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: Confirmed from the provided content: 3B non-embedding parameters; 28T pretraining tokens; ablation-style conclusions that from-scratch looped > upcycling, two passes work best, and KV-cache sharing trades memory for weaker gains. The paper claims strong results on code-agent/office-agent/tool-use benchmarks, reportedly outperforming larger open models (e.g., Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-12B), but the excerpt does not include the concrete tables, evaluation protocols, or agent framework controls—those are essential to validate the claims and should be checked in the full experiments section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (45–60 minutes):
- For pretraining/architecture: focus on the Pre-Training section covering from-scratch vs upcycling, loop depth selection, and KV-cache sharing.
- For pretrain↔posttrain interface: read the RL pipeline motivation (mixed-mode RLHF, length control) and what failure modes they target.
- In experiments, prioritize the looped-architecture comparison tables and the definition/measurement of “token efficiency”, then verify agent benchmark setups (tooling, scaffolds, sampling, reproducibility).

recommendation.zh: 不是看它 3B 打赢谁，而是看小模型 agentic RL recipe 怎么拼；优先读后训练消融，预训练 28T 更像成本宣言而非 insight。
recommendation.en: Do not read this for the leaderboard claim; read it for how the agentic RL recipe is assembled in a 3B model, while treating the 28T pretraining scale mostly as a budget statement.

paper.title: Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning research is constant algorithm modification, new estimators, new pipeline stages, new rollout schemes, and in mainstream frameworks each change threads through layers of trainer, distributed backend, and rollout glue: the cost lands on the researcher at every iteration. Molt is a PyTorch-native training framework built to keep that cost small: a codebase compact and clean enough for a researcher to hold in their head, and for an AI coding assistant to read and reas

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是 agentic RL 研究迭代成本过高：算法一改，trainer、分布式后端和 rollout glue 都要跟着改，导致研究速度慢、代码难以维护。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是系统与研究基础设施，而不是新 RL 算法。对 pretrain 研究员的价值在于它强调一种更轻量、PyTorch-native、可被研究者完整掌握的训练栈，这对 RL-pretrain 接口、异步训练语义和 MoE/多模态策略训练有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Molt，一个 PyTorch-native 的 agentic RL 训练框架。核心设计是把 agent 视为普通程序，用单一异步循环统一 rollout 与训练，并强调严格的 token / policy version / model semantics 一致性，避免训练到模型未实际生成过的 token。框架声称支持多模态和 MoE policy，并尽量减少研究者在系统胶水层的负担。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出详细规模，但声称在 matched、fully asynchronous protocol 下，Molt 与一个 SOTA Megatron-based stack 在统计上可比。若正文实验只证明“同等效果但代码更轻”，那它更像工程取舍展示；值得关注的是其异步一致性定义和 never-train-on-unseen-token 约束是否真的减少了 RL 训练中的语义漂移。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Jan Kautz、Pavlo Molchanov，偏 NVIDIA 系统/生成式 AI 研究脉络。团队在高性能训练与生成模型系统上有长期积累。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the high iteration cost of agentic RL research, where every algorithmic change tends to propagate through the trainer, distributed backend, and rollout glue code.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a systems and research-infrastructure contribution rather than a new RL algorithm. For pretraining researchers, the value is in its lightweight PyTorch-native stack, asynchronous training semantics, and support for multimodal and MoE policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors present Molt, a PyTorch-native framework for agentic RL. The key idea is to treat the agent as an ordinary program and run a single asynchronous loop that unifies rollout and training, while enforcing consistency in tokens, policy versions, and model semantics so the model never trains on tokens it did not generate. The framework is designed to support multimodal and MoE policies with minimal systems overhead for researchers.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide detailed scale numbers, but claims that under a matched fully asynchronous protocol, Molt is statistically comparable to a state-of-the-art Megatron-based stack. If the full paper mainly shows parity with a much leaner codebase, the real value is in the training semantics and engineering simplification rather than raw algorithmic gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Jan Kautz and Pavlo Molchanov, which places the work in the NVIDIA-style systems/generative AI lineage. The team has a strong background in high-performance training infrastructure.

recommendation.zh: 不是算法 paper，而是训练栈 paper；做 RL-pretrain 或 agentic RL 基建的人可看其异步一致性约束，其他人读 abstract 和系统图就够了。
recommendation.en: This is a training-stack paper, not an algorithm paper; if you build RL-pretrain or agentic RL infrastructure, inspect the async consistency semantics, otherwise the abstract and system diagram are enough.

paper.title: Masked Diffusion Language Models are Strong and Steerable Text-Based World Models for Agentic RL
paper.abstract: Recent growth in reinforcement learning (RL) has surfaced a need for diverse, specialized training environments. Hand-curated environments with fixed task and reward difficulties become ineffective signals as model performance improves, and sparse rewards over long horizons induce mode collapse on specific workflows or tool structures. summary.core_problem: 用 masked diffusion LM 替代自回归 LM 作为文本世界模型，为 agentic RL 提供可全局条件化、可按需扩展多样性的环境动力学模拟器。
summary.importance: 把离散 diffusion LM 的 any-order 特性直接用到 agent world model 场景，指出 AR 左到右偏置在全局状态锚点（工具 schema、历史轮次、期望结果）条件化上的结构性缺陷；同时提供了跨 9 个开源环境、12 个前沿模型族的 239k 条 grounded 轨迹数据。
summary.technical_approach: 将文本世界建模形式化为 steerable transition-dynamics 问题，分解为初始状态、任务上下文、工具 schema、领域规则、steering directives；用 masked diffusion LM 做 any-order 条件生成，允许在任意位置锚定全局约束后并行补全状态转移，而不是 AR 的单向 rollout。
summary.experiments: 构建 239,403 条 grounded state-action 轨迹，覆盖 9 个开源环境和 12 个前沿模型族；对比 AR world model 在 rollout 质量、全局条件一致性、多样性上的表现（abstract 截断，具体数值未给出）。

summary_en.core_problem: Use masked diffusion language models instead of autoregressive LMs as text-based world models, providing globally conditionable, on-demand diversity for agentic RL environment simulation.
summary_en.importance: Exploits the any-order nature of discrete diffusion LMs for agent world modeling, identifying a structural limitation of AR left-to-right bias when conditioning on globally interdependent state anchors (tool schemas, prior turns, expected outcomes); also contributes 239k grounded trajectories across 9 open-source environments and 12 frontier model families.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes text-based world modeling as a steerable transition-dynamics problem decomposed into initial state, task context, tool schemas, domain rules, and steering directives; uses a masked diffusion LM for any-order conditional generation, allowing arbitrary global anchors to be fixed before parallel state completion rather than unidirectional AR rollout.
summary_en.experiments: Curates 239,403 grounded state-action trajectories spanning 9 open-source environments and 12 frontier model families; compares against AR world models on rollout quality, global conditioning consistency, and diversity (abstract truncated, exact numbers not provided).

recommendation.zh: 把 MDLM 类 any-order LM 拉到 world model 场景是少见的对位论证，重点看它如何量化 AR 左到右偏置在全局锚点条件化上的损失。
recommendation.en: A rare head-to-head argument for any-order LMs as world models; focus on how they quantify AR left-to-right bias under global-anchor conditioning.

paper.title: WAR: Workload-Aware Rollouts for Synchronous Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Long-horizon rollout generation has become the dominant systems bottleneck in agentic reinforcement learning (RL). As agents interact with environments over many turns, trajectories rapidly grow to tens of thousands of tokens, making synchronous RL training increasingly constrained by rollout. We propose WAR, a workload-aware rollout system that substantially accelerates synchronous agentic RL by jointly optimizing decoding and scheduling. summary.core_problem: 同步智能体强化学习中长视野rollout生成成为系统瓶颈，现有推测解码方法需要额外草稿模型易产生GPU资源争抢。
summary.importance: 系统创新，针对agent RL训练的rollout瓶颈提出负载感知的联合解码与调度方案，无需额外草稿模型即可实现低负载下的解码加速。
summary.technical_approach: 提出WAR负载感知rollout系统，根据运行时负载动态切换优化策略：低负载下采用无模型SuffixDecoding，复用已完成轨迹的后缀模式作为推测草稿，无需额外draft模型避免GPU争抢；高负载下的优化策略在摘要中截断未完全披露。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型规模、基线对比、加速比等量化实验结果，仅给出了核心设计思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon rollout generation has become the dominant bottleneck for synchronous agentic RL, while existing speculative decoding methods require extra draft models that cause GPU contention.
summary_en.importance: Systems innovation that proposes a workload-aware joint decoding and scheduling solution for agent RL rollout bottlenecks, enabling decoding acceleration under low load without additional draft models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes WAR, a workload-aware rollout system that switches strategies dynamically by runtime load: under low load, it uses model-free SuffixDecoding that reuses suffix patterns from completed trajectories as speculative drafts, avoiding GPU contention from extra draft models; the high-load strategy is truncated in the abstract.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose quantitative results including model sizes, baselines, or speedup ratios, only presenting core design ideas.

recommendation.zh: Agent RL训练rollout加速的工程trick，无新范式，做RL训练系统的可以扫一眼后缀复用思路，其他人跳过。
recommendation.en: An engineering trick for agent RL rollout acceleration with no paradigm novelty; skim the suffix reuse idea if you work on RL training infra, otherwise skip.

paper.title: When Does Muon Help Agentic Reinforcement Learning?
paper.abstract: Muon is competitive with AdamW in large-scale pre-training, but its value for reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training remains unclear. summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 Muon 优化器在 agentic RL post-training 中什么时候有效。已有证据显示 Muon 在大规模预训练中能提高训练效率，但在 RLVR 和 SFT 中结果不稳定。作者把问题缩小到长程、稀疏奖励的 agent 环境，并考察优势估计器是否会改变 Muon 的收益。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的价值在于优化器迁移和 post-train 接口。Muon 的谱归一化更新在预训练中有吸引力，但 RL 梯度的噪声结构不同，直接替换 AdamW 可能不稳。论文提供了一个有用线索：优化器效果不能只看目标函数名称，还要看 advantage estimator 如何改变 token-level score gradient 的加权和谱结构。对后续研究来说，这提示 Muon、Hopper、Pion 这类谱操作优化器需要和 credit assignment 一起评估，而不是只做单一 RLVR 设置。
summary.technical_approach: 实验使用 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 在 ALFWorld 上做稀疏奖励 agentic RL。Muon 只用于 policy 的 hidden weight matrices，embedding、norm 和其他参数保持 AdamW 配置，以减少优化器切换带来的破坏。作者比较三类 group-based RL：GRPO 使用 episode-level advantage；GiGPO 在相同 episode-level term 上加入 anchor-state grouping 得到的 step-level advantage；GraphGPO 把 rollout 聚合成状态转移图，并用到目标的 successor-state distance 给 transition-level credit。技术解释围绕梯度信噪比展开：Muon 会通过近似正交化 flatten 更新的奇异值谱，放大弱方向；如果弱方向主要是噪声，就会失败，如果 advantage estimator 提供更稳定的局部对比，Muon 可能受益。
summary.experiments: 主要实验是单种子匹配比较。GiGPO 下，Muon 相比 AdamW 将最终窗口验证成功率从 0.290 提高到 0.546，相对提升 88%；最终 checkpoint 为 0.63 对 0.32。学习率控制显示，单纯提高 AdamW 学习率不能复现该收益：AdamW 在 1e-5 和 3e-5 的 post-update validation success 都为 0，而 Muon 在 3e-5 到 200 update 仍保持非零成功率。GRPO 下，Muon 在 3e-5 将最终窗口均值从 0.161 提到 0.268，收益小于 GiGPO。GraphGPO 下，由于性能接近饱和，后期差距较小：3e-5 时 Muon 为 0.83，AdamW 为 0.81；normalized validation AUC 为 0.47 对 0.40。1e-5 的 GraphGPO Muon 达到 0.901，normalized AUC 为 0.56，并更早跨过成功率阈值。限制也很明显：模型只有 0.5B，环境集中在 ALFWorld，且核心结果是 single-seed。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–40 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 Muon 预训练结果、RLVR 负结果和本工作正结果的对照。Preliminaries 里重点看 GRPO、GiGPO、GraphGPO 的 advantage 形式，尤其是 GiGPO 如何从 GRPO 加入 step-level credit。实验部分优先看 GiGPO 的 AdamW/Muon 主对比、学习率控制、2×2 ablation，以及跨 advantage estimator 的曲线。若关注优化器机制，重点读 gradient SNR conjecture；若关注可靠结论，需要注意 single-seed 和小模型限制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when the Muon optimizer helps in agentic RL post-training. Muon has shown strong efficiency in large-scale pretraining, but prior RL and SFT evidence is mixed. The authors narrow the question to long-horizon sparse-reward agents and test whether the advantage estimator changes Muon’s behavior.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is the optimizer interface between pretraining and post-training. Muon’s spectral normalization of momentum can be useful in pretraining, but RL policy gradients have a different noise profile. The paper suggests that optimizer choice should be evaluated together with credit assignment: the advantage estimator changes the scalar weights applied to token-level score gradients, which may change the aggregate gradient spectrum and the signal-to-noise ratio seen by Muon.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study trains a Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct agent on ALFWorld. Muon is applied only to hidden weight matrices, while embeddings, normalization parameters, and other parameters keep the AdamW baseline setup. The comparison covers GRPO with episode-level advantages, GiGPO with an additional anchor-state step-level term, and GraphGPO with transition-level credit from a state-transition graph. The proposed interpretation is gradient-SNR based: Muon flattens the singular spectrum of the update and can amplify weak directions. If those directions are mostly sampling noise, Muon may fail; if the estimator provides more reliable local contrasts, the same spectral operation can help.
summary_en.experiments: The key results are matched single-seed comparisons. Under GiGPO, Muon increases final-window validation success from 0.290 to 0.546, an 88% relative gain, and reaches 0.63 versus 0.32 at the final checkpoint. Learning-rate controls show that a larger AdamW rate does not explain the result: AdamW at 1e-5 and 3e-5 has zero post-update validation success, while Muon at 3e-5 keeps nonzero validation success through 200 updates. Under GRPO at 3e-5, Muon improves the final-window mean from 0.161 to 0.268. Under GraphGPO, late performance nearly saturates, so the final gap is small: 0.83 for Muon versus 0.81 for AdamW at 3e-5, with normalized validation AUC of 0.47 versus 0.40. At 1e-5, GraphGPO with Muon reaches 0.901 and normalized AUC 0.56. The main caveats are the single-seed design, the 0.5B model scale, and the focus on one environment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Read the introduction for the contrast between positive pretraining evidence, negative RLVR reports, and the agentic RL setting studied here. In the preliminaries, focus on the differences among GRPO, GiGPO, and GraphGPO, especially the step-level credit term in GiGPO. In the experiments, prioritize the GiGPO AdamW-vs-Muon comparison, learning-rate controls, the 2×2 ablation, and the estimator-dependent curves. Readers interested in optimizer mechanisms should read the gradient-SNR discussion carefully, while keeping the single-seed limitation in mind.

recommendation.zh: 读结果表和学习率交互即可；单 seed 不够硬，但 Muon 用在 RL 后训练值得内部复验。
recommendation.en: Read the result tables and LR interaction; single-seed evidence is weak, but Muon in RL post-training deserves an internal replication.

paper.title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly trained as interactive agents for long-horizon tasks involving multi-turn interaction, tool use, and environment feedback. Outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) provides a practical optimization paradigm, but its sparse trajectory-level rewards offer limited guidance on intermediate decisions, leaving a supervision gap between episode-level outcomes and token-level policy learning. We propose SEED (SElf-Evolving On-Policy Distillation), a self-evolving

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agentic RL 中一个很具体的监督缺口：环境通常只给 trajectory-level 的 outcome reward，但策略学习发生在 token/action 级别，长时程交互里很难把“最后成没成功”有效分配到中间每一步。论文想解决的不是再造一个更强的 RL 算法，而是把 on-policy 轨迹在事后暴露出的结构化信息——哪些观察关键、哪些工具调用有用、哪里偏离了有效流程——转成可训练的密集监督，并且让这套监督随着策略演化而持续更新。
summary.importance: 它属于 post-train/agent RL 范畴，不是预训练论文，但对基座研究有两个启发。第一，长时程 agent 学习里，单靠 outcome reward 的信息密度太低，必须引入更细粒度的训练信号；这和预训练里讨论 token-level loss 是否足够表达复杂能力是同一类问题。第二，论文把“hindsight skill”做成参数化蒸馏信号，而不是部署时外挂 memory 或 reflection prompt，这对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口有参考意义：很多看似 inference-time 的策略知识，最终都可以回流成模型内部参数。贡献量级上，它更像一个训练框架设计，而不是基础算法突破；价值主要在于把 on-policy distillation、trajectory hindsight 和 self-improving agent 这三件事接到一起。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名 SEED，核心是 self-evolving on-policy distillation。整体分两阶段。

第一阶段是 hindsight-skill SFT。作者先让模型学会分析完整轨迹，并把轨迹压缩成自然语言 skill，内容包括可复用 workflow、关键观察、失败规避规则等。这里 skill 不是给用户看的总结，而是训练期的 privileged signal。这样做的目的，是把原本分散在长轨迹里的后见之明提炼成一个更紧凑、可条件化的表示。

第二阶段是自演化的 OPD 训练循环。当前策略先在环境中按 on-policy 方式采样轨迹；同一个模型随后扮演 analyzer，对这些已完成轨迹生成 hindsight skills。接着，作者固定采样得到的原始动作序列，不重新搜索动作，而是分别在“普通上下文”和“skill 增强上下文”下对这些已发生动作重新打分。两者的概率差异被解释为 skill 对行为的偏好修正，并转成 token-level 的 distillation 信号。最终优化目标是 outcome-based RL loss 与这个 OPD loss 的联合。

这里有几个设计点值得注意。其一，为什么强调 on-policy：因为 skill 的价值依赖当前策略会访问哪些状态、会犯哪些错，离线静态 skill 库很快就会失配。其二，为什么用同一个模型同时做 actor 和 analyzer：不是为了省模型，而是为了让“会做事”和“会复盘”一起进化，避免 teacher 固定不动。其三，为什么不把 skill 直接放到推理时：作者希望把 hindsight 变成参数内化的能力，而不是额外的 inference-time memory 机制。

从方法关系上看，它和 verbal reflection、episodic memory、self-distillation 有亲缘性，但区别在于：SEED 不把反思文本当外部记忆长期挂在上下文里，而是把 skill 仅作为训练期 privileged context，通过概率重打分产生密集监督；也不同于纯 outcome RL，因为它提供了 decision-level credit signal；也不同于传统 teacher-student distillation，因为 teacher 不是外部更强模型，而是同一策略在更有 hindsight 的条件下的“增强视角”。
summary.experiments:
论文在 embodied interaction、web navigation、search-based 等长时程 agent 环境上做评测，目标是验证 SEED 是否能比只用 outcome reward 的 RL 学得更稳、更快。虽然给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，但从实验设计可以看出作者主要验证四件事。

第一，联合 OPD 后，任务成功率相对纯 RL 基线有稳定提升，说明 hindsight skill 确实提供了额外可学习信号，而不是只增加训练噪声。第二，这种提升不是来自 inference-time 提示增强，因为 skill 只在训练时使用，测试时不需要额外 memory 或 prompt。第三，自演化机制优于静态 skill 或一次性蒸馏：随着策略变强，后续生成的 skills 也更贴近当前分布，能继续提供有效监督。第四，token-level 重打分比只在轨迹级别做偏好学习更有效，因为它把 trajectory hindsight 下沉到了具体决策位置。

如果看消融，最值得关注的通常是：去掉 skill analyzer 只做 RL；使用固定 analyzer 或离线 skill 数据；把 skill 当作测试时外部提示而不是训练期蒸馏；以及只做 sequence-level distillation 不做 token-level probability shift。论文的主张成立，依赖的是这几项对照能把收益来源拆清楚。

从研究判断上，这类结果更应关注增益是否跨环境稳定、训练成本增加多少、以及 analyzer 生成的 skill 质量是否会在策略早期阶段成为瓶颈。若全文表格里有 sample efficiency、success rate 曲线、以及不同 horizon 任务上的收益差异，这些比单点平均分更值得看。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction，明确作者要补的是 sparse outcome reward 与 token-level policy learning 之间的监督缺口。然后直接看方法图和 OPD 目标定义，弄清楚 skill 是如何从 completed trajectory 生成、又如何通过重打分变成密集监督的。这里是整篇工作的核心。

实验部分建议优先看三类内容：主结果表，确认相对纯 RL 和其他 hindsight/reflective baselines 的提升；消融，确认 self-evolving、on-policy、token-level distillation 各自的必要性；案例分析，看看生成的 skills 到底是泛化的 workflow 还是只是对单条轨迹的复述。预计 35-45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。

更值得深挖的问题有两个。第一，skill 生成质量是否会受模型当前能力上限约束，导致早期自举不稳。第二，OPD 的概率差分是否会引入偏置：skill-augmented context 下更高概率的动作，未必总是因果上更优，只是更符合 analyzer 的语言解释。若要复现，这两点需要重点盯。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific supervision gap in agentic reinforcement learning. In long-horizon interactive environments, the agent often receives only sparse trajectory-level outcome rewards, while policy learning happens at the token or action level. That makes credit assignment extremely weak: a final success or failure says little about which intermediate observations, tool calls, or local decisions should be reinforced. The paper does not propose a new RL optimizer. Instead, it asks how to convert hindsight information from completed on-policy trajectories into dense training signals that can guide token-level policy updates.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and agent-RL paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant for foundation-model researchers for two reasons. First, it highlights a general issue: coarse end-level supervision is often too weak for learning complex sequential behavior, so denser internal training signals matter. Second, it shows a concrete way to turn what would otherwise be inference-time reflection or memory into parametric supervision. That is useful for thinking about the pretrain-posttrain interface: some forms of external reasoning support can be distilled back into the model rather than carried forever as prompts or memory. The contribution is best understood as a training framework that combines hindsight skill extraction, on-policy data, and self-distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SEED stands for Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation. The framework has two stages.

Stage one is hindsight-skill supervised fine-tuning. The model is trained to analyze completed trajectories and produce natural-language skills that summarize reusable workflows, decisive observations, and failure-avoidance rules. These skills are not meant as user-facing summaries. They are privileged training-time signals that compress trajectory-level hindsight into a compact, conditionable representation.

Stage two is the self-evolving OPD loop. The current policy collects trajectories on-policy in the environment. The same model then acts as an analyzer and generates hindsight skills for those completed trajectories. Next, the sampled action sequence is kept fixed. The model re-scores those already-taken actions under two contexts: the original context and a skill-augmented context. The probability shift between the two is treated as a dense token-level distillation signal that indicates how hindsight would have changed the policy’s preference over the observed decisions. Training then jointly optimizes the standard outcome-based RL objective and this OPD objective.

Three design choices are central. First, the method is on-policy because useful hindsight depends on the states and failure modes induced by the current policy; a static offline skill bank would quickly become mismatched. Second, the actor and analyzer are the same evolving model, so decision-making ability and trajectory-analysis ability improve together instead of relying on a frozen teacher. Third, skills are used only during training, not at inference time, because the goal is to internalize hindsight into the policy parameters rather than depend on external memory or extra prompts.

Relative to nearby work, SEED is related to verbal reflection, episodic memory, and self-distillation, but it differs in a precise way. It does not keep reflection text as persistent inference-time context. It uses hindsight text only as privileged context during training to produce dense supervision. It also differs from pure outcome-based RL by providing decision-level credit signals, and from standard teacher-student distillation by using the same policy under a more informed hindsight-conditioned view rather than an external stronger teacher.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates SEED on long-horizon agent settings including embodied interaction, web navigation, and search-based tasks. The main empirical question is whether hindsight-skill distillation improves learning beyond outcome-only RL. The full excerpt provided here does not include the complete result tables, but the experimental structure makes the intended claims clear.

First, adding OPD on top of outcome-based RL improves task success over pure RL baselines, suggesting that hindsight skills provide learnable supervision rather than just extra noise. Second, the gains are not due to inference-time prompting, because the skills are used only during training and are not required at test time. Third, the self-evolving loop outperforms static skills or one-shot distillation, which supports the claim that hindsight supervision should track the current policy distribution. Fourth, token-level re-scoring is more effective than staying at the trajectory level, because it pushes hindsight information down to concrete decision points.

The most informative ablations are likely the following: removing the skill analyzer and keeping only RL, replacing the evolving analyzer with a fixed analyzer or offline skill dataset, using skills as test-time prompts instead of training-time distillation, and replacing token-level probability-shift supervision with sequence-level distillation only. Those comparisons are what establish where the gains actually come from.

From a research perspective, the most important things to inspect are whether the gains are stable across environments, how much extra training cost the analyzer loop adds, and whether skill quality becomes a bottleneck early in training when the policy is still weak. If the paper reports sample-efficiency curves, success-rate trajectories, and breakdowns by task horizon, those are more informative than a single averaged score.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction to pin down the exact problem: sparse trajectory-level rewards are too coarse for token-level policy learning. Then go straight to the method figure and the OPD objective. The key is to understand how a completed trajectory is turned into a hindsight skill, and how that skill is converted into dense supervision through action re-scoring. That is the conceptual center of the paper.

In the experiments, prioritize three things: the main result table against pure RL and other hindsight or reflection baselines, the ablations that isolate self-evolving, on-policy, and token-level components, and the qualitative examples of generated skills. Those examples matter because they reveal whether the model is extracting reusable workflows or merely paraphrasing individual trajectories. A useful skim should take about 35-45 minutes.

Two deeper questions are worth tracking. One is whether skill generation quality is limited by the current policy’s own capability, which could make early self-bootstrapping unstable. The other is whether the probability shift under skill-augmented context introduces bias: an action can become more likely because it matches the analyzer’s verbal explanation, not necessarily because it is causally better. Those are the main points to watch if you plan to reproduce or extend the method.

recommendation.zh: 值得看训练环路而不是结果表；若 on-policy 自解释不塌缩，内部 Agent RL 可复现 skill 蒸馏消融。
recommendation.en: Read the training loop more than the score table; if on-policy self-analysis does not collapse, the skill-distillation ablation is worth reproducing internally.
